note: Read-only, default-world numerical scan. It uses the current accepted buttress convex hull, exact Three.js yaw transform, complete hull-boundary samples, all nearby generated sources/homes/solid scenery, and the full locked R2 lattice. It is not a native projection, collision, or placement approval.

method.support: all transformed hull vertices + three samples per hull edge + origin; free-standing span <= .32m
method.embedded: span > .32m recorded as embedded-only rather than lowering the free-standing guard; baseY is full footprint minimum
method.route: minimum hull-boundary to every R2 lattice segment >=1.2m
method.sources: resource footprint +1.2m approach buffer against hull boundary
method.scenery: no overlap with current solid canopy/Fen-stone owner footprint
